historical_record.description: Built for the Buon Gusto Sausage Factory.
Built as an industrial building for Buon Gusto Sausage Factory, to the design of Martin Rist, one of the modern architects the city's survey identifies as working in North Beach.

Recorded in the city's 1982 survey of North Beach, adopted by the Board of Supervisors in 1999, as a contributor to the Upper Dupont Street / Grant Avenue District. It is listed on the National Register of Historic Places (SG100006073).
Listed as National Register of Historic Places SG100006073 — Buon Gusto Sausage Factory.
Identified by the 2019 updated North Beach survey as appearing eligible for local landmark or California Register / National Register status — recorded as the Buon Gusto Sausage Factory.

unknowns: The city's survey gives 1926 as the construction date in its property-type chapter and lists the same building in Appendix C as designed by Martin Rist in 1946.
